Below the Critical threshold the deficiency penalty can fire (unless Pause Days are banked); at or above the Sufficient threshold it counts as fully recovered. IGUI_HARMONIE_AdminPauseDaysTooltip: Banked days that pause BOTH this vitamin's daily Reserve decay AND its critical-deficiency penalty, whichever it's needed for. 1 day is consumed per in-game day. IGUI_GTPG_HowItWorks:
There are six vitamins: A, B, C, D, E and K. Each has a Reserve from 0 to %1. Below %2 it is Critical, below %3 Low, otherwise Sufficient.
Every day each vitamin's Reserve drops by %4.
Eating food adds Reserve. Eating a whole day's need of a vitamin gives +%5. Eating half a food gives half.
Every %6 Reserve you gain banks 1 pause day. A day with a banked pause day uses it up instead of dropping, and that vitamin's deficiency effects stay quiet. Eat well every day and you stay ahead.
When a vitamin falls below %2 its deficiency starts. The effects stay until the Reserve is back up to %3, not just out of Critical, like a real deficiency.
Stale or rotten food gives fewer vitamins. Vitamins follow how much hunger the food still fills.
Your character also mentions how they feel now and then while something is short.
IGUI_GTPG_EffectsOn: Deficiency effects are on in this world (the Vitamins tab says what each one does). On top of those, each vitamin in deficiency lowers your highest Endurance by 10 percent, and this stacks: three vitamins short = at most 70 percent.
IGUI_GTPG_EffectsOff: Deficiency effects are switched off on this server (sandbox). The bands still change, but nothing hurts.

IGUI_GTPG_FoodsHint: Numbers = Reserve one whole serving gives. Click a vitamin picture to sort by it, or Food for A-Z. A home-canned jar gives 4 times its fresh food.
IGUI_GTPG_Vit_A_Effect: Blurred vision. The game's blur-vision level stays at 30 or more, so your hits are weaker and aiming is harder. The vanilla Drunk moodle may show for it, but it is the vitamin, not alcohol.
IGUI_GTPG_Vit_A_Why: Real life: vitamin A keeps the eyes working, above all in dim light. Without it come night blindness and dry, sore eyes.
IGUI_GTPG_Vit_B_Effect: Stress never falls below 30 percent, and the Stressed moodle stays.
IGUI_GTPG_Vit_B_Why: Real life: the B vitamins keep the nerves and the blood healthy. Without them come tingling and numb hands and feet, headaches from anaemia and tiredness, which add up to stress.
IGUI_GTPG_Vit_C_Effect: Every game hour there is a 5 percent chance of a bleeding scratch on the head (a nosebleed or bleeding gums), if the head is not already bleeding. Bandage it like any scratch.
IGUI_GTPG_Vit_C_Why: Real life: lack of vitamin C is scurvy. Gums bleed, the nose bleeds easily and small wounds heal slowly.
IGUI_GTPG_Vit_D_Effect: Every body part stays at least 20 stiff: aching, stiff muscles all over.
IGUI_GTPG_Vit_D_Why: Real life: vitamin D keeps bones and muscles strong. Without it come bone pain, muscle aches and weak muscles.
IGUI_GTPG_Vit_E_Effect: Unhappiness never falls below 30, and the Unhappy moodle stays, which slows you down.
IGUI_GTPG_Vit_E_Why: Real life: vitamin E protects nerves and muscles. Without it come clumsy, weak muscles and poor coordination.
IGUI_GTPG_Vit_K_Effect: Your overall health cannot go above 90 (10 lower than normal).
IGUI_GTPG_Vit_K_Why: Real life: vitamin K makes blood clot. Without it you bruise and bleed easily and wounds heal slowly.
IGUI_GTPG_Other_Pills_Body:
Taking vitamin pills (a vanilla item) gives every vitamin +1 pause day: for about a day nothing drops and deficiency effects are quiet. It does not raise the Reserve. It is relief, not a cure, so you still need to eat.
Make them (Medical, keep a mortar and pestle): 1 empty jar, 1 salt, and one of each: carrot / sweet potato / pumpkin; egg / beef / chicken / pork / venison / rabbit; bell pepper / tomato / orange / lemon; salmon / fish fillet / milk; peanuts / soybeans; broccoli / cabbage / spinach.
IGUI_GTPG_Other_Canning_Body:
Cooking recipe: 1 empty tin can + 4 of the same vegetable or fruit + 1 salt = a sealed home-canned jar. 39 kinds of produce work.
A sealed jar never spoils. Open it with a can opener. Once open it is fresh for 2 days and rotten after 4.
A jar holds the vitamins of 4 fresh pieces, so it is the way to keep summer vitamins for winter.
IGUI_GTPG_Other_Cooking_Body: Stews, soups and other pot or pan dishes keep the vitamins of everything you put in, by how much of each went in. Eating part of the dish gives that part. Mixing vegetables, meat and fish in one pot covers many vitamins at once.
IGUI_GTPG_Other_Fresh_Body: Vitamins follow how much hunger a food still fills. When food goes stale or rotten the game lowers that, and the vitamins drop with it. Eat produce fresh, keep it cold, or can it.
IGUI_GTPG_Other_NotTracked_Body: Milk and anything else you drink from a container, candy and snacks, herbs, spices and seeds. Canned condensed milk (a solid food) does count. A food not in the All foods tab gives no vitamins.
IGUI_GTPG_Other_Tips_Body:
- D is the hardest one: fish (salmon is best), eggs, cheese, butter, mushrooms.
- B: meat, fish, beans and lentils, peanuts.
- A: carrots, sweet potatoes, leafy greens, butter, eggs.
- C: bell peppers, oranges, pineapple, broccoli, brussels sprouts, rosehips.
- K: leafy greens such as kale, spinach, dandelions, grape leaves and brussels sprouts.
- E: olive or vegetable oil, nuts, avocado, beans.
A vegetable garden, some fishing and eggs cover all six. Sort the All foods tab by a vitamin to see what to grow or find.
